name: @activepieces/piece-wonderchat
description: Wonderchat is a no-code chatbot platform that lets you deploy AI-powered chatbots for websites quickly.

auth.description:
1. Log in to your Wonderchat account.
  2. Click on your **Profile card**.
  2. Go to your **User settings**.
  3. Click on the the **API keys** tab.
  3. If you already have a key, copy it, if not generate one.

askQuestion.name: askQuestion
askQuestion.description: Sends a question to a Wonderchat bot; returns the bot’s answer.

chatbotId.description: The ID of your chatbot (can be found in the URL when viewing your bot: /bot/YOUR_BOT_ID)

question.description: The question you wish to ask your chatbot

chatlogId.description: The ID of your chat session (can be found under Chatlog Details section, labeled as "ID")

context.description: Additional custom context about the chat session (e.g., user information)

contextUrl.description: URL of the page the user is on to provide additional context

aiMetadata.description: Sends a question to a specific Wonderchat chatbot (identified by chatbotId) and returns the bot’s generated answer. Use to query a deployed knowledge-base chatbot programmatically. Optionally pass a chatlogId to continue an existing chat session plus custom context/contextUrl to ground the answer. Not idempotent: each call posts a new message and produces a fresh AI-generated reply.

addPage.name: addPage
addPage.description: Add new pages to your chatbot’s knowledge base.

chatbotId.description: The ID of your chatbot (can be found in the URL when viewing your bot: /bot/YOUR_BOT_ID)

urls.description: List of webpage URLs to add to your chatbot's knowledge base (e.g., "https://wonderchat.io")

sessionCookie.description: Session cookie for crawling sites behind login

aiMetadata.description: Adds one or more webpage URLs to a specific Wonderchat chatbot’s knowledge base (identified by chatbotId), triggering Wonderchat to crawl and ingest them. Use when an agent needs to expand or update what a bot can answer from. Optionally provide a session cookie to crawl pages behind a login. Not idempotent: each call appends/re-ingests pages into the knowledge base.

addTag.name: addTag
addTag.description: Add custom tags to a specific chatlog.

chatlogId.description: The ID of your chat session (can be found under Chatlog Details section, labeled as "ID")

tags.description: List of URLs to add to your chatbot

aiMetadata.description: Adds one or more custom tags to a specific Wonderchat chatlog (chat session identified by chatlogId). Use to label or categorize a conversation. Idempotent: tags are applied as a set, so re-adding the same tags leaves the chatlog’s tag set unchanged.

removeTag.name: removeTag
removeTag.description: Remove specific tags from a chatlog.

chatlogId.description: The ID of your chat session (can be found under Chatlog Details section, labeled as "ID")

aiMetadata.description: Removes one or more tags from a specific Wonderchat chatlog (chat session identified by chatlogId). Use to clear or correct labels on a conversation. Idempotent: re-running with the same tags leaves the chatlog’s tag set unchanged once those tags are already absent.

newUserMessage.name: newUserMessage
newUserMessage.description: Triggers when a new message is sent by a user in a specific chatlog.

chatlogId.description: The ID of your chat session (can be found under Chatlog Details section, labeled as "ID")

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an end user sends a new message in a specific Wonderchat chat session (identified by chatlogId). Polls the chatlog’s messages and emits only newly arrived user-typed messages (bot replies are excluded). Use to react to incoming visitor messages in a single tracked conversation.

de.Wonderchat is a no-code chatbot platform: Wonderchat ist eine No-Code-Chatbot-Plattform, mit der Sie auf Webseiten schnell KI-gestützte Chatbots bereitstellen können.
de.\n 1. Log in to your Wonderchat account:
1. Melden Sie sich bei Ihrem Wonderchat-Konto an.
  2. Klicke auf deine **Profilkarte**.
  2. Gehe zu deinen **Benutzereinstellungen**.
  3. Klicken Sie auf die Registerkarte **API-Schlüssel**
  3. Wenn Sie bereits über einen Schlüssel verfügen, kopieren Sie ihn, wenn er nicht generiert wird.
